sources.name: Project synthetic test fixtures
sources.provenance: Generated manually for this repository; no real horse or race data.
sources.reason: Safe for tests and examples, but not suitable for model training.

sources.name: JRA public race pages (private local use)
sources.scope: Current JRA race cards, meeting conditions, and linked past race results
sources.declared_license: No open-data license; JRA website terms apply
sources.provenance: Public pages published by the Japan Racing Association and acquired directly by the user on their own machine.
sources.reason: Approved only for conservative, rate-limited acquisition for the user's private local analysis. The fetcher requires an explicit acknowledgement, records every URL and hash, and raw or derived row-level data must never be committed or redistributed. This is not an open-data approval.

sources.name: JRA-VAN Data Lab.
sources.scope: Licensed JRA historical, weekly, and real-time JV-Data
sources.declared_license: Paid subscriber service terms and official JV-Link SDK
sources.provenance: JRA official data delivered by JRA Systems Service through the documented JV-Link interface.
sources.reason: Approved only for a subscriber's local analysis through JV-Link. Monthly subscription and a supported Windows environment are required; raw or derived row-level data must not be committed or redistributed.

sources.name: JRA Horse Racing Dataset by takamotoki
sources.provenance: Dataset description states that records were scraped from netkeiba.com.
sources.reason: The Kaggle license is explicit, but authority to license the scraped source data has not been established.

sources.name: KBlueLeaf/jp-racing-horse
sources.provenance: Dataset card contains only the license declaration and does not identify the original data source or collection method.
sources.reason: A repository license alone does not establish provenance or permission for the database contents.

sources.name: 地方競馬情報サイト データダウンロード
sources.scope: NAR race information from 1998; odds from 2026-03
sources.declared_license: Official terms; no open-data license identified
sources.provenance: CSV and ZIP files published by the National Association of Racing official site.
sources.reason: Strong official provenance, but it covers local racing rather than JRA and redistribution permission needs confirmation.
